issues: 八张卡是 200→354 的饱和彩虹渐变，卡面只有几何符号 + CARD 0X 编号 + 两根骨架条
环前后的卡亮度完全一样，没有空气透视，背面卡和正面卡在画面里抢戏
地面反光盘放在卡片下方很远处，画面里几乎看不到，环像悬在空中
3D 层在 480×270 设计坐标里 transform 放大，卡面文字与细边发软
背景是单一径向渐变，没有颗粒，暗部有色带
changes: 卡面改为同色系石墨模板卡（色相 228→263 微调）：渐变图标块 + 标题/副标题 + 八种迷你图表，1px 低透明发丝线 + 顶部内高光 + 卡顶径向受光
按卡在环上的方位角 (1−cosθ)/2 叠深色压暗层（最后方 62%），前后层次一眼可读
地面盘挪到卡脚下（y=66），并加一份以地面为镜面的 scaleY(−1) 倒影环（叶子层 16% 透明度 + 渐隐 mask，不拍平 3D）
DesignStage 改 raster=zoom，3D 层按目标分辨率栅格化，文字锐利；几何（半径/透视/俯角）与匀速一圈完全不变，首尾帧仍无缝
背景换成深色柔光底（中心主光 + 靛蓝余光 + 暗角 + 颗粒）
issuesEn: The eight cards used a saturated 200→354 rainbow gradient, with faces made of a glyph, a CARD 0X label and two skeleton bars
Front and back cards had identical brightness, no aerial perspective, so back cards competed with the front
The floor disc sat far below the cards and was barely visible; the ring looked like it was floating
The 3D layer was transform-upscaled from 480×270 design space, so card text and hairlines were soft
Single radial-gradient background with no grain, banding in the darks
changesEn: Faces are single-family graphite template cards (hue 228→263): gradient icon tile, title/subtitle and eight mini charts, low-alpha hairline, top inner highlight and a top sheen
A dark overlay scaled by (1−cosθ)/2 of each card's ring angle (62% at the back) makes depth instantly readable
The floor disc now sits right under the cards (y=66), plus a scaleY(−1) reflection ring mirrored about the floor (16% opacity and fade mask on leaf faces so 3D isn't flattened)
DesignStage uses raster=zoom so the 3D layer rasterizes at target resolution; geometry (radius/perspective/tilt) and the single constant-speed loop are unchanged, still seamless
Dark soft-lit backdrop (center key light, indigo spill, vignette, grain)
